name: ai-software-delivery-room
description: Multi-agent software delivery for Claude: idea validation (desk evidence, a synthetic persona panel, optional MiroFish); discovery with features, flows and test cases; architecture where you choose monolith or microservices and how portable to be, with costs; sprints through whole user journeys with independent QA; live browser tests, also on your cloud; reports and manuals; a dashboard with forecast and run cost; and assessments of existing systems.
